headline: Thailand September Car Production Drops 6.08% While Exports Rise 4.55%
summary: Thailand's car production decreased by 6.08% year-on-year in September, whereas car exports increased by 4.55% over the same period.
why: Automotive manufacturing and export data from Thailand serve as a key proxy for industrial activity and trade demand in Southeast Asia.

impacts.name: Automotive
impacts.why: Lower domestic production contrasted with rising export volumes shows uneven demand across local and international markets.
